text:
Ms Mary Wright
Community Nurse
Lakeside Community Health Centre
50 Hope Street
Newtown

24 January, 2018

Dear Ms Wright,

Re: Ms Jane Simms, aged 46

I am writing regarding Ms Simms who has been treated with exacerbation of her progressive multiple sclerosis. As her condition is stabilised, she is due for discharge tomorrow, and requires follow-up care.  

During hospitalization, several health problems of Ms Simms were identified and treated. She has been prescribed antidepressants, and has received occupational therapy for her depression since stopping work. Her weight was managed with a low calorie diet and our exercise program. The pressure sore at her right buttock has been dressed daily, and is now healed. Overall, she has made good progress.

In terms of her medications, 150 mg of Prothiaden once a day has recently been prescribed, for which it needs to be monitor after discharge. The details of other medications will be forwarded to her on discharge day.

Would you please monitor her weight control as well as encourage her to continue the exercise program and develop new activities and interests? Her skin integrity also needs to be checked regularly.     

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
RN (176W)
